svg.title: Target motion: independent bias-corrected replication for frozen policy F
svg.desc: (a) Schematic of arms H (training law), E0 static, E1 constant velocity, E2 obstacle-aware. (b) Capture by arm in the seven-seed replication: E0 82.39% < E1 84.32% < H 87.76% < E2 89.12%. (c) Seed-paired differences vs H: E0 −5.37 pp, E1 −3.45 pp, E2 +1.35 pp; all three met the preregistered directional replication criterion. The original three-seed legacy-window campaign is shown beside it and not pooled. (d) Quota minus legacy window by arm. Simulation only.
